component.name: Go RomM Sync
component.summary: A seamless bridge between RomM and RetroArch for a console-like gaming experience

description.p: Go RomM Sync is a desktop companion for your retro gaming collection. It connects directly to your self-hosted RomM server to synchronize ROMs, saves, states, and covers, providing a console-like gaming experience powered by RetroArch.

ul.li: Browse and manage your RomM retro gaming library with spatial navigation support
Automatic core resolution and RetroArch configuration management
Two-way save file and save state synchronization with RomM
Customizable controller support and per-game remapping

screenshot.caption: Game Detail Page with Server and Local Saves

description.p: Release v0.2.2: RetroArch installer and manager integration, improved Wii controls, and stability enhancements.
